b3.07: Policy is a redirection of institutional levers from the intervention year onward (seamlessly continuing the original trajectory), not a societal response to policy — see contract §8c and §9.
b3.08: Technological penetration on this path never crossed the 0.68 decision line: gravity values are still computed, but history has not entered adjudication and remains suspended.
b3.09: Same technology, different institutional choices. Note that the six paths share nearly identical technological conditions yet end in opposite outcomes — this is "institutions decide which side you land on".
b3.10: "Consistency" = the share of main outcomes across 240 runs with ±8% perturbation (seeded, reproducible on refresh); lower means the outcome is more fragile.
b3.11: Dual gate GATE_PEN 0.68 ∧ GATE_SOC 0.48 plus feudalism gravity; the v1.2 rent pressure indicator is its explicit early-warning readout.
b3.12: The meaning / coordination levers are qualitative proxies; contract §9 declares this one of the model's strongest assumptions.
b3.13: Narratively, 2024 should be the transition from prehistory to algorithmic capitalism. The stage track now marks stage 0 as "prehistory".
b3.14: Only when technological penetration ≥ 0.68 ∧ socialization ≥ 0.48 both cross their gates does history point toward communism; miss either and it falls into another steady state (compute feudalism / reformed stagnation / collapse). Technology alone or will alone is not sufficient.
b3.15: "In place of the old bourgeois society, with its classes and class antagonisms, we shall have an association, in which the free development of each is the condition for the free development of all."
b3.16: Its value lies not in predicting what will happen in which year, but in laying out the conditions: technology supplies possibilities, institutions decide which side you land on, and institutions do not evolve automatically — they are written by people who organize. Every coefficient in the model is a debatable judgment; you can move the levers and see whether it still holds up.
